magnitude_tier_rule: tier refers to the primary metric: subtle ~5-12% relative (or +2-5 pts on a small-base rate), medium ~15-35% relative (or +6-12 pts), large >=50% relative (or >=15 pts)

novel_faults.primary_metric: resolution rate on acme_cards_v3 (secondary: llm error rate model.context_overflow)
novel_faults.description: A much longer system prompt on acme_cards_v3 makes long conversations (turn>=5) overflow the context window (llm_call error model.context_overflow); those sessions end in handoff/abandonment. Reverted day 35.
WhatsApp Business API message delivery delays grow over 10 days; a few extra percent of whatsapp conversations are abandoned mid-way. No config marker.

Raised handoff threshold on nw_returns_v3 escalates ~3.5% of otherwise-resolved conversations early (measured lift also contains ~1pt from planted F2, whose order_status slice overlaps this agent in days 33-47). Not rolled back inside the corpus, but the fault window is closed at day 49 (weekly routing re-tune restored behaviour without a logged change).
A card-processor client upgrade makes ~10% of block_card calls time out (5-12s); affected sessions mostly hand off. Fixed day 21.

benign_events.description: New v3 agent acme_wealth_v3 launched day 12, taking 30% of acme_cards_v3/acme_lending_v3 traffic. It performs like its peers (born healthy); the peer agents lose volume but not quality.

planted_faults.signature: new product line launches with no KB content; kb_lookup returns no confident hit; answers fall through to a generic reply
planted_faults.primary_effect: cohort resolution_rate falls to ~0.3 against a tenant standard above 0.8 — exact figures in observed_effects.F1
planted_faults.aggregate_effect: tenant containment moves ~2pt — invisible without cohorting

planted_faults.signature: tool returns HTTP 200 with an empty payload on ~13% of calls; outcome is recorded 'ok' so every error-rate metric reads flat
planted_faults.primary_effect: same-tool retry within session, then unresolved end
planted_faults.aggregate_effect: tool_error_rate FLAT — the fault is invisible to the obvious metric and only shows in downstream behaviour

planted_faults.signature: prompt v4 makes the agent over-confirm; turns-to-resolve rises ~60% while resolution rate stays flat
planted_faults.primary_effect: median turns ~4 -> ~6 (mean +58%); cost per session roughly +80%; resolution flat — exact figures in observed_effects.F3
planted_faults.aggregate_effect: resolution FLAT — threshold alerting on outcome metrics misses this entirely; only a standard-relative measure sees it

planted_decoys.signature: campaign drives 5.1x branch_locator volume (a trivially contained intent); AGGREGATE containment RISES while every cohort is flat or slightly worse
planted_decoys.correct_reading: not a quality event in either direction — stratify by intent

planted_decoys.signature: flash sale, 3.3x volume; p95 latency doubles and timeouts rise, then self-corrects. Quality is flat throughout
planted_decoys.correct_reading: a reliability event for the platform view, not a quality regression; it self-corrects inside the sustain window

planted_decoys.signature: quality rubric v1 -> v2 is stricter; judged scores drop ~0.6 across BOTH tenants at once. judge_version is stamped on every judged value, so the information needed to refuse the comparison is present in the data
planted_decoys.correct_reading: do not trend judged quality across the boundary; re-score or segment by judge_version
